files.purpose: Canonical schema DDL — updated for Sprint02. Adds restock_quantity column to items table and creates shopping_tasks table. All changes use ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency.
key_details: ALTER TABLE storagetracker.items ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS restock_quantity integer CHECK (restock_quantity IS NULL OR restock_quantity >= 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS storagetracker.shopping_tasks (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), item_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES storagetracker.items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','done','dismissed')), source_tags jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, notes text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), completed_at timestamptz)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_shopping_tasks_item_open ON storagetracker.shopping_tasks (item_id) WHERE status = 'open'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_shopping_tasks_status ON storagetracker.shopping_tasks(status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_shopping_tasks_item_id ON storagetracker.shopping_tasks(item_id)

files.purpose: All item and history endpoints. Extended in Sprint02 to include restock_quantity field handling and auto-task creation.
key_details: ItemCreate: add restock_quantity: Optional[int] = None
ItemUpdate: add restock_quantity: Optional[int] = None
Validate restock_quantity >= 0 if provided in both POST and PATCH handlers
Add _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item_id: str, source_tags: list) helper — checks for open task, inserts if absent
In item_create: after insert, if final_state in ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock'), call _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item_id, source_tags)
In item_update: after update and auto-transition, if final_state in ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock'), call _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item_id, item.source_tags)
IMPORTANT: _ensure_open_shopping_task must run within the same connection/transaction as the item write
Route ordering unchanged: view routes before parameterised routes

files.purpose: All shopping task endpoints. New file in Sprint02.

methods.name: __init__
methods.purpose: Pydantic model for PATCH /api/shopping-tasks/{id} body. status must be done or dismissed.

methods.name: list_shopping_tasks
methods.purpose: GET /api/shopping-tasks — list tasks with optional status and source_tag filters. JOIN to items for item_name. Returns Dataset.

methods.name: create_shopping_task
methods.purpose: POST /api/shopping-tasks — validate item exists, check for open task (409), copy source_tags, insert task row. Returns Dataset.

methods.name: view_by_source
methods.purpose: GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source — fetch open tasks joined to items, expand to one flat row per (task, source_tag), use 'Other' for tasks with no source tags. Returns Dataset with ShoppingTaskRow columns plus source_tag.

methods.name: update_shopping_task
methods.purpose: PATCH /api/shopping-tasks/{id} — close task (done/dismissed), apply restock logic on done, record history if item state changes. Returns Dataset.

methods.name: delete_shopping_task
methods.purpose: DELETE /api/shopping-tasks/{id} — delete task, return empty Dataset or 404.

files.route_registration_note: IMPORTANT: Register view route GET /shopping-tasks/views/by_source BEFORE parameterised route GET /shopping-tasks/{id} in this file.

files.purpose: Pytest test file for all shopping task scenarios defined in 10_test_spec.md.

public_objects.name: test_manual_task_creation
public_objects.purpose: Given a stored item, POST /shopping-tasks creates an open task. Task source_tags match item source_tags.

public_objects.name: test_duplicate_open_task_rejected
public_objects.purpose: POST /shopping-tasks for an item that already has an open task returns 409.

public_objects.name: test_auto_task_creation_on_low_stock
public_objects.purpose: PATCH item to low_stock state creates a shopping task automatically.

public_objects.name: test_auto_task_not_duplicated
public_objects.purpose: PATCH item to low_stock when open task already exists does not create a second task.

public_objects.name: test_task_done_with_restock_quantity
public_objects.purpose: PATCH task to done when item has restock_quantity: item.quantity updated, state re-evaluated.

public_objects.name: test_task_done_without_restock_quantity
public_objects.purpose: PATCH task to done when item has no restock_quantity: item.state set to stored.

public_objects.name: test_task_dismissed
public_objects.purpose: PATCH task to dismissed: item state unchanged, task.completed_at set.

public_objects.name: test_list_tasks_default_open
public_objects.purpose: GET /shopping-tasks returns only open tasks by default.

public_objects.name: test_by_source_grouping
public_objects.purpose: GET /shopping-tasks/views/by_source returns rows grouped by source_tag; tasks with no tags appear in Other group.

public_objects.name: test_by_source_multi_tag_duplication
public_objects.purpose: A task with multiple source_tags appears in each corresponding group in by_source view.

public_objects.name: test_delete_task
public_objects.purpose: DELETE /shopping-tasks/{id} removes the task; subsequent GET returns 404.

public_objects.name: test_item_delete_cascades_to_tasks
public_objects.purpose: DELETE /items/{id} removes the item and its open shopping task.
